title: Printable coordinate grid sheet (lesson 67)
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y8 lesson 67 (Printable coordinate grid sheet (portal worksheet for this lesson))
intro: Lesson 67: Reflecting shapes in lines. To understand how to reflect shapes in horizontal and vertical lines on a coordinate grid

model.title: Reflect the triangle (1, 1), (4, 1), (1, 3) in the y-axis.

parts.label: Step 1
parts.text: Each point goes the same distance to the other side

model.title: Reflect the point (5, 2) in the line x = 3.

parts.label: Step 1
parts.text: (5, 2) is 2 to the right of x = 3

parts.label: Step 2
parts.text: The image is 2 to the left of x = 3

questions.q: Reflect (-3, 4) in the y-axis and in the x-axis.
questions.model: y-axis: x changes sign, (3, 4). x-axis: y changes sign, (-3, -4).

questions.q: Triangle T has vertices (1, 2), (3, 2) and (3, 5). Reflect T in (a) the y-axis (b) the x-axis (c) x = 4 (d) y = 1. Write each image's coordinates.
questions.model: (a) Each x changes sign: (1, 2) goes to (-1, 2), and so on. (c) (1, 2) is 3 left of x = 4, so its image is 3 right: (7, 2).

questions.q: A shape is reflected in x = 2 and one image vertex is (-1, 4). Where was the original vertex?
Reflect (a, b) in the line x = k. Write the image in terms of a, b and k.
Is the image congruent to the object?
Big question: where does a reflected shape go, and what stays the same?
questions.a: The same distance to the other side of the mirror line; size, shape and angles stay the same, but it is flipped.
